```{r}
library(data.table)
library(DT)
library(ggplot2)
library(htmltools)
library(htmlwidgets)
library(jsonlite)
library(readxl)

snapshot <- readRDS(params$snapshot_path)
report_root <- dirname(normalizePath(params$snapshot_path))
assets_root <- file.path(report_root, "assets")
dir.create(assets_root, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

`%||%` <- function(x, y) if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0L) y else x

slug <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]+", "_", as.character(x))
  gsub("^_+|_+$", "", x)
}

safe_fread <- function(path) {
  if (is.null(path) || is.na(path) || !file.exists(path)) return(data.table())
  tryCatch(fread(path, skip = "VARIABLE"), error = function(e) {
    tryCatch(fread(path), error = function(e2) data.table())
  })
}

paths_for <- function(base_dir) {
  regenie_input_file <- file.path(base_dir, "regenie_input_dir.txt")
  regenie_input_dir <- if (file.exists(regenie_input_file)) {
    trimws(readLines(regenie_input_file, warn = FALSE)[1])
  } else NULL

  list(
    loci = file.path(base_dir, "loci", "ALL_TRAITS.loci_table.tsv"),
    loci_rsid = file.path(base_dir, "loci", "ALL_TRAITS.loci_table_with_rsid.tsv"),
    candidate_dir = file.path(base_dir, "ld", "candidate_snps"),
    gwas_catalog_dir = file.path(base_dir, "novelty_check"),
    pubmed_dir = file.path(base_dir, "novelty_check", "PubMed"),
    snpeff_dir = file.path(base_dir, "SnpEff"),
    snpeff_prop = file.path(base_dir, "SnpEff", "all_trait_prop.tsv"),
    magma_dir = file.path(base_dir, "magma"),
    mh_dir = file.path(base_dir, "mh_plots"),
    qq_dir = file.path(base_dir, "qqplot"),
    locuszoom_dir = file.path(base_dir, "LZplot"),
    gene_mh_dir = file.path(base_dir, "mh_plots_gene"),
    tophits_dir = if (!is.null(regenie_input_dir)) file.path(regenie_input_dir, "tophits") else NULL
  )
}

read_run_params <- function(base_dir) {
  path <- file.path(base_dir, "run_params.json")
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(NULL)
  tryCatch(jsonlite::read_json(path), error = function(e) NULL)
}

get_novelty_method <- function(base_dir, trait) {
  params <- read_run_params(base_dir)
  if (is.null(params)) return("Method not recorded (run_params.json not found)")

  nv <- params$novelty
  trait_map <- nv$trait_map_xlsx %||% ""
  def_str   <- nv$default_trait_string %||% ""

  if (nzchar(trait_map) && trait_map != "path/to/file/" && file.exists(trait_map)) {
    tryCatch({
      # Read trait map — support xlsx, csv, tsv
      suffix <- tolower(tools::file_ext(trait_map))
      tm <- if (suffix %in% c("xlsx", "xls")) {
        readxl::read_excel(trait_map)
      } else if (suffix == "csv") {
        read.csv(trait_map, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      } else {
        read.delim(trait_map, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      }
      colnames(tm) <- tolower(trimws(colnames(tm)))
      col_trait   <- names(tm)[tolower(names(tm)) == "trait"][1]
      col_efo     <- names(tm)[tolower(names(tm)) == "efo_id"][1]
      col_catalog <- names(tm)[tolower(names(tm)) %in% c("gwas_catalog_trait", "catalog_trait")][1]

      if (!is.na(col_trait)) {
        row <- tm[trimws(as.character(tm[[col_trait]])) == trait, ]
        if (nrow(row) > 0) {
          catalog_label <- if (!is.na(col_catalog)) trimws(as.character(row[[col_catalog]][1])) else NA
          efo           <- if (!is.na(col_efo))     trimws(as.character(row[[col_efo]][1]))     else NA
          display <- if (!is.na(catalog_label) && nzchar(catalog_label) && catalog_label != "NA") {
            catalog_label
          } else trimws(as.character(row[[col_trait]][1]))
          if (!is.na(efo) && nzchar(efo) && efo != "NA") {
            return(paste0("EFO-based matching: <strong>", htmlEscape(display),
                         "</strong> (EFO: ", htmlEscape(efo), ")"))
          } else {
            return(paste0("EFO-based matching: <strong>", htmlEscape(display), "</strong>"))
          }
        }
      }
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
  }

  if (nzchar(def_str)) {
    return(paste0("String-based matching: <strong>", htmlEscape(def_str), "</strong>"))
  }
  "Matching method not specified"
}

find_snp_col <- function(dt) {
  if (!nrow(dt)) return(NA_character_)
  clean <- toupper(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "", names(dt)))
  hit <- match(c("CANDIDATESNP", "RSID", "SNP", "ID"), clean, nomatch = 0)
  if (any(hit > 0)) names(dt)[hit[hit > 0][1]] else NA_character_
}

candidate_p_col <- function(dt) {
  hit <- which(toupper(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "", names(dt))) == "CANDIDATEP")
  if (length(hit)) names(dt)[hit[1]] else NA_character_
}

list_traits <- function(base_dir) {
  p <- paths_for(base_dir)
  traits <- character()
  if (dir.exists(p$mh_dir)) {
    f <- list.files(p$mh_dir, pattern = "_mh(_maffilt)?\\.html$")
    f <- f[!grepl("^combined_mh", f)]
    traits <- c(traits, sub("_mh(_maffilt)?\\.html$", "", f))
  }
  if (dir.exists(p$candidate_dir)) {
    f <- list.files(p$candidate_dir, pattern = "\\.candidate_snps\\.tsv$")
    traits <- c(traits, sub("\\.candidate_snps\\.tsv$", "", f))
  }
  if (dir.exists(p$qq_dir)) {
    f <- list.files(p$qq_dir, pattern = "_qqplot\\.png$", ignore.case = TRUE)
    traits <- c(traits, sub("_qqplot\\.png$", "", f, ignore.case = TRUE))
  }
  if (dir.exists(p$gwas_catalog_dir)) {
    f <- list.files(p$gwas_catalog_dir, pattern = "_novel\\.tsv$")
    traits <- c(traits, sub("_novel\\.tsv$", "", f))
  }
  if (dir.exists(p$pubmed_dir)) {
    f <- list.files(p$pubmed_dir, pattern = "_pubmed\\.tsv$")
    traits <- c(traits, sub("_pubmed\\.tsv$", "", f))
  }
  if (dir.exists(p$snpeff_dir)) {
    f <- list.files(p$snpeff_dir, pattern = "_snpeff_refined\\.tsv$", recursive = TRUE)
    traits <- c(traits, sub("_snpeff_refined\\.tsv$", "", basename(f)))
  }
  magma_specs <- list(
    c("gene_analysis", "\\.genes\\.symbol\\.tsv$"),
    c("gene_set_analysis", "\\.gsa\\.out$"),
    c("tissue_analysis", "\\.gsa\\.out$")
  )
  for (spec in magma_specs) {
    d <- file.path(p$magma_dir, spec[1])
    if (dir.exists(d)) {
      f <- list.files(d, pattern = spec[2])
      traits <- c(traits, sub(spec[2], "", f))
    }
  }
  loci_dt <- safe_fread(if (file.exists(p$loci_rsid)) p$loci_rsid else p$loci)
  if (nrow(loci_dt) && "trait" %in% names(loci_dt)) {
    traits <- c(traits, as.character(loci_dt$trait))
  }
  sort(unique(traits))
}

read_candidates <- function(base_dir, trait, format_p = TRUE) {
  dt <- safe_fread(file.path(paths_for(base_dir)$candidate_dir,
                             paste0(trait, ".candidate_snps.tsv")))
  p_col <- candidate_p_col(dt)
  if (!nrow(dt) || is.na(p_col) || !format_p) return(dt)
  pos <- match(p_col, names(dt))
  p <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(dt[[p_col]]))
  dt[, `-log10P (candidate SNP)` := round(-log10(pmax(p, .Machine$double.xmin)), 3)]
  dt[, (p_col) := NULL]
  new_order <- append(setdiff(names(dt), "-log10P (candidate SNP)"),
                      "-log10P (candidate SNP)", after = pos - 1)
  setcolorder(dt, new_order)
  dt
}

read_trait_loci <- function(base_dir, trait) {
  p <- paths_for(base_dir)
  dt <- safe_fread(p$loci_rsid)
  if (!nrow(dt)) dt <- safe_fread(p$loci)
  if (!nrow(dt) || !"trait" %in% names(dt)) return(data.table())
  selected_trait <- as.character(trait)
  dt[as.character(get("trait")) == selected_trait]
}

read_optional_sections <- function(base_dir, trait) {
  p <- paths_for(base_dir)
  snpeff_1 <- file.path(p$snpeff_dir, paste0(trait, "_snpeff_refined.tsv"))
  snpeff_2 <- file.path(p$snpeff_dir, "output", paste0(trait, "_snpeff_refined.tsv"))

  list(
    novelty = safe_fread(file.path(p$gwas_catalog_dir, paste0(trait, "_novel.tsv"))),
    other_traits = safe_fread(file.path(
      p$gwas_catalog_dir, paste0(trait, "_othertraits_in_window.tsv")
    )),
    pubmed = safe_fread(file.path(p$pubmed_dir, paste0(trait, "_pubmed.tsv"))),
    snpeff = if (file.exists(snpeff_1)) safe_fread(snpeff_1) else safe_fread(snpeff_2),
    magma_genes = safe_fread(file.path(
      p$magma_dir, "gene_analysis", paste0(trait, ".genes.symbol.tsv")
    )),
    magma_genesets = safe_fread(file.path(
      p$magma_dir, "gene_set_analysis", paste0(trait, ".gsa.out")
    )),
    magma_tissues = safe_fread(file.path(
      p$magma_dir, "tissue_analysis", paste0(trait, ".gsa.out")
    ))
  )
}

read_snpeff_proportions <- function(base_dir, trait) {
  dt <- safe_fread(paths_for(base_dir)$snpeff_prop)
  if (!nrow(dt) || !"trait" %in% names(dt)) return(dt)
  selected_trait <- as.character(trait)
  dt[as.character(get("trait")) == selected_trait]
}

find_p_column <- function(dt) {
  if (!nrow(dt)) return(NA_character_)
  clean <- toupper(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "", names(dt)))
  priority <- c("P", "PVAL", "PVALUE", "PJOINT", "PSELF", "PCOND", "PFULL")
  hit <- match(priority, clean, nomatch = 0)
  if (any(hit > 0)) return(names(dt)[hit[hit > 0][1]])
  p_like <- grep("^P", clean)
  if (length(p_like)) names(dt)[p_like[1]] else NA_character_
}

find_label_column <- function(dt, candidates) {
  if (!ncol(dt)) return(NA_character_)
  clean <- toupper(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "", names(dt)))
  wanted <- toupper(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "", candidates))
  hit <- match(wanted, clean, nomatch = 0)
  if (any(hit > 0)) names(dt)[hit[hit > 0][1]] else names(dt)[1]
}

make_magma_plot <- function(dt, label_candidates, title, top_n = 20) {
  if (!nrow(dt)) return(NULL)
  p_col <- find_p_column(dt)
  label_col <- find_label_column(dt, label_candidates)
  if (is.na(p_col) || is.na(label_col)) return(NULL)
  plot_dt <- copy(dt)
  plot_dt[, p_numeric := suppressWarnings(as.numeric(get(p_col)))]
  plot_dt <- plot_dt[is.finite(p_numeric) & p_numeric > 0]
  if (!nrow(plot_dt)) return(NULL)
  plot_dt[, score := -log10(p_numeric)]
  # Use ENTREZID/first col as fallback when label is NA
  plot_dt[, label_raw := as.character(get(label_col))]
  fallback_col <- names(plot_dt)[1]
  plot_dt[is.na(label_raw) | label_raw == "NA" | !nzchar(label_raw),
          label_raw := as.character(get(fallback_col))]
  plot_dt <- plot_dt[!is.na(label_raw) & label_raw != "NA" & nzchar(label_raw)]
  if (!nrow(plot_dt)) return(NULL)
  setorder(plot_dt, -score)
  plot_dt <- head(plot_dt, top_n)
  plot_dt[, label := factor(label_raw, levels = rev(label_raw))]
  ggplot(plot_dt, aes(label, score)) +
    geom_col(fill = "#D64550") +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "-log10(P)", title = title) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
}


add_log10p_and_sort <- function(dt) {
  dt <- copy(dt)
  p_col_idx <- which(toupper(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "", names(dt))) %in% c("P","PVAL","PVALUE"))
  if (length(p_col_idx)) {
    p_col_name <- names(dt)[p_col_idx[1]]
    dt[, `-log10(P)` := round(-log10(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(get(p_col_name)))), 4)]
    new_order <- append(setdiff(names(dt), "-log10(P)"), "-log10(P)", after = p_col_idx[1])
    setcolorder(dt, new_order)
    dt <- dt[order(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(get(p_col_name))))]
  }
  dt
}

find_locuszoom <- function(base_dir, trait, lead) {
  lz_dir <- paths_for(base_dir)$locuszoom_dir
  if (!dir.exists(lz_dir)) return(NA_character_)
  safe_trait <- slug(trait)
  safe_lead <- slug(lead)
  files <- list.files(lz_dir, pattern = "\\.html$", full.names = TRUE)
  exact <- files[basename(files) == paste0(safe_trait, "_", safe_lead, ".html")]
  if (length(exact)) return(exact[1])
  hit <- files[
    grepl(paste0("^", safe_trait, "_"), basename(files)) &
    grepl(safe_lead, basename(files), fixed = TRUE)
  ]
  if (length(hit)) hit[1] else NA_character_
}

find_qq <- function(base_dir, trait) {
  qdir <- paths_for(base_dir)$qq_dir
  if (!dir.exists(qdir)) return(NA_character_)
  files <- list.files(qdir, pattern = "\\.png$", full.names = TRUE)
  safe_trait <- slug(trait)
  hit <- files[grepl(safe_trait, basename(files), fixed = TRUE) &
                 grepl("qq", basename(files), ignore.case = TRUE)]
  if (length(hit)) hit[1] else NA_character_
}

relative_asset <- function(...) file.path("assets", ...)

copy_html_asset <- function(source, dataset_key, trait_key) {
  if (!file.exists(source)) return(NA_character_)
  rel_dir <- relative_asset(dataset_key, trait_key, "manhattan")
  out_dir <- file.path(report_root, rel_dir)
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  file.copy(source, file.path(out_dir, basename(source)), overwrite = TRUE)

  dependency_dir <- paste0(tools::file_path_sans_ext(source), "_files")
  if (dir.exists(dependency_dir)) {
    file.copy(dependency_dir, out_dir, recursive = TRUE, overwrite = TRUE)
  }
  file.path(rel_dir, basename(source))
}

copy_qq_asset <- function(source, dataset_key, trait_key) {
  if (is.na(source) || !file.exists(source)) return(NA_character_)
  rel_dir <- relative_asset(dataset_key, trait_key)
  out_dir <- file.path(report_root, rel_dir)
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  destination <- file.path(out_dir, basename(source))
  file.copy(source, destination, overwrite = TRUE)
  file.path(rel_dir, basename(source))
}

copy_locuszoom_asset <- function(source, dataset_key, trait_key, lead_key) {
  if (is.na(source) || !file.exists(source)) return(NA_character_)
  rel_dir <- relative_asset(dataset_key, trait_key, "locuszoom", lead_key)
  out_dir <- file.path(report_root, rel_dir)
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  destination <- file.path(out_dir, basename(source))
  file.copy(source, destination, overwrite = TRUE)

  dependency_dir <- paste0(tools::file_path_sans_ext(source), "_files")
  if (dir.exists(dependency_dir)) {
    file.copy(dependency_dir, out_dir, recursive = TRUE, overwrite = TRUE)
  }
  file.path(rel_dir, basename(source))
}

normalise_table_for_display <- function(dt) {
  x <- as.data.table(copy(dt))
  clean_names <- as.character(names(x))
  clean_names[is.na(clean_names) | !nzchar(clean_names)] <- "column"
  setnames(x, make.unique(clean_names, sep = "_"))
  for (nm in names(x)) {
    value <- x[[nm]]
    if (is.list(value)) {
      value <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(x)), function(i) {
        v <- unlist(value[[i]], recursive = TRUE, use.names = FALSE)
        paste(as.character(v[!is.na(v)]), collapse = "; ")
      }, character(1))
    } else if (inherits(value, c("integer64","POSIXct","POSIXlt","Date","IDate","difftime")) ||
               is.factor(value) || !is.atomic(value)) {
      value <- as.character(value)
    }
    if (!is.character(value)) value <- as.character(value)
    value[is.na(value)] <- ""
    set(x, j = nm, value = value)
  }
  as.data.frame(x, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
}

save_table_asset <- function(dt, rel_file) {
  if (!nrow(dt)) return(NA_character_)
  absolute_file <- file.path(report_root, rel_file)
  dir.create(dirname(absolute_file), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  widget <- datatable(
    dt, rownames = FALSE, filter = "top",
    options = list(pageLength = 20, scrollX = TRUE, deferRender = TRUE)
  )
  saveWidget(widget, absolute_file, selfcontained = FALSE, title = "GWAS table")
  rel_file
}

emit_iframe <- function(src, height = 560) {
  if (is.na(src)) {
    cat("<p class='text-muted'>Not available.</p>\n\n")
  } else {
    cat(sprintf(
      "<iframe src='%s' style='width:100%%;height:%dpx;border:1px solid #ddd;border-radius:4px;'></iframe>\n\n",
      htmlEscape(src, attribute = TRUE), height
    ))
  }
}

emit_table_iframe <- function(src, n_rows = NULL) {
  if (is.na(src)) {
    cat("<p class='text-muted'>Not available.</p>\n\n")
    return(invisible())
  }
  # Auto-size based on rows: ~28px per row + 120px overhead, min 180, max 650
  if (!is.null(n_rows)) {
    height <- max(180, min(650, min(n_rows, 20) * 28 + 120))
  } else {
    height <- 400
  }
  cat(sprintf(
    "<iframe src='%s' style='width:100%%;height:%dpx;border:1px solid #ddd;border-radius:4px;'></iframe>\n\n",
    htmlEscape(src, attribute = TRUE), height
  ))
}

emit_image <- function(src) {
  if (is.na(src)) {
    cat("<p class='text-muted'>QQ plot not available.</p>\n\n")
  } else {
    cat(sprintf(
      "<img src='%s' style='display:block;max-width:480px;width:100%%;height:auto;margin:0 auto;' alt='QQ plot'>\n\n",
      htmlEscape(src, attribute = TRUE)
    ))
  }
}

emit_ai_block <- function(assessment, dataset_label, trait, section) {
  if (is.null(assessment) || !length(assessment$insights)) return(invisible(NULL))
  selected <- Filter(function(item) {
    identical(as.character(item$dataset_label), as.character(dataset_label)) &&
      identical(as.character(item$trait), as.character(trait)) &&
      identical(as.character(item$section), as.character(section))
  }, assessment$insights)
  if (!length(selected)) return(invisible(NULL))

  cat("<div class='ai-insight'>")
  cat("<div class='ai-insight-title'>AI-supported interpretation</div>")
  cat("<p class='ai-disclaimer'>Generated from the displayed evidence; this is a cautious synthesis, not an additional association analysis.</p>")
  for (item in selected) {
    cat("<div class='ai-insight-item'>")
    cat("<p>", htmlEscape(item$text %||% ""), "</p>", sep = "")
    cat(
      "<p class='ai-evidence'><strong>Evidence:</strong> ",
      htmlEscape(paste(unlist(item$evidence_ids %||% list()), collapse = ", ")),
      " &nbsp; <strong>Confidence:</strong> ",
      htmlEscape(item$confidence %||% "not stated"), "</p>", sep = ""
    )
    limitations <- unlist(item$limitations %||% list())
    if (length(limitations)) {
      cat("<p class='ai-detail'><strong>Limitations:</strong> ",
          htmlEscape(paste(limitations, collapse = "; ")), "</p>", sep = "")
    }
    follow_up <- item$follow_up %||% ""
    if (nzchar(follow_up)) {
      cat("<p class='ai-detail'><strong>Suggested follow-up:</strong> ",
          htmlEscape(follow_up), "</p>", sep = "")
    }
    cat("</div>")
  }
  cat("</div>\n\n")
  invisible(NULL)
}

# New format (schema_version 2.0): render loci-based assessment
emit_ai_new_format <- function(assessment) {
  s <- function(...) paste0(...)
  safe_text <- function(x) {
    x <- htmlEscape(as.character(x %||% ""))
    gsub("\\{", "{{", gsub("\\}", "}}", x))
  }
  # Summary
  if (!is.null(assessment$summary) && nzchar(assessment$summary %||% "")) {
    cat(s('<div style="padding:12px 16px; background:#f4f8fb; border-left:4px solid #3c8dbc; border-radius:4px; margin-bottom:16px;">',
          "<strong>Summary: </strong>", safe_text(assessment$summary), "</div>\n"))
  }
  # Key takeaway
  if (!is.null(assessment$key_takeaway) && nzchar(assessment$key_takeaway %||% "")) {
    cat(s('<div style="padding:10px 16px; background:#eafaf1; border-left:4px solid #27ae60; border-radius:4px; margin-bottom:16px;">',
          "<strong>Key finding: </strong>", safe_text(assessment$key_takeaway), "</div>\n"))
  }
  # Loci
  loci <- assessment$loci %||% list()
  if (length(loci)) {
    cat("<h5>Locus-by-locus summary</h5>\n")
    for (locus in loci) {
      novelty_color <- switch(locus$novelty %||% "Unknown",
        "Novel" = "#27ae60", "Known" = "#e67e22", "#888")
      cat(s(
        '<div style="background:#fff; border:1px solid #e0e0e0; border-radius:6px; padding:12px 16px; margin-bottom:10px; border-left:4px solid #3498db;">',
        "<strong>", safe_text(locus$lead_snp %||% ""), "</strong>",
        ' &nbsp; <span style="color:#888; font-size:12px;">-log10P = ', safe_text(locus$log10p %||% ""), "</span><br>",
        "Nearest gene: <strong>", safe_text(locus$nearest_gene %||% "N/A"), "</strong> &nbsp; ",
        '<span style="font-weight:600; color:', novelty_color, ';">', safe_text(locus$novelty %||% "Unknown"), "</span><br>",
        '<span style="font-size:12px; color:#555;">', safe_text(locus$novelty_detail %||% ""), "</span>"
      ))
      if (!is.null(locus$interpretation) && nzchar(locus$interpretation %||% "")) {
        cat(s('<br><em style="color:#444;">', safe_text(locus$interpretation), "</em>"))
      }
      cat("</div>\n")
    }
  }
  # Pathway / tissue
  if (!is.null(assessment$pathway_enrichment) && nzchar(assessment$pathway_enrichment %||% "")) {
    cat(s('<div style="padding:10px 16px; background:#f5eef8; border-left:4px solid #8e44ad; border-radius:4px; margin-top:12px;">',
          "<strong>Pathway enrichment: </strong>", safe_text(assessment$pathway_enrichment), "</div>\n"))
  }
  if (!is.null(assessment$tissue_enrichment) && nzchar(assessment$tissue_enrichment %||% "")) {
    cat(s('<div style="padding:10px 16px; background:#fef9e7; border-left:4px solid #f39c12; border-radius:4px; margin-top:8px;">',
          "<strong>Tissue enrichment: </strong>", safe_text(assessment$tissue_enrichment), "</div>\n"))
  }
  invisible(NULL)
}

ai_assessment_for_trait <- function(snapshot, dataset_id, trait) {
  if (is.null(snapshot$ai) || !isTRUE(snapshot$ai$included)) return(NULL)
  assessments <- snapshot$ai$assessments %||% list()
  assessments[[paste(dataset_id, trait, sep = "::")]]
}

emit_ai_trait_section <- function(assessment, dataset_label, trait) {
  cat("\n### AI-supported insights\n\n")
  if (is.null(assessment)) {
    cat("<p class='text-muted'>No completed cached AI assessment is available for this trait.</p>\n\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  # New format (schema_version 2.0) uses $loci instead of $insights
  schema_version <- assessment$schema_version %||% "1.0"
  if (!is.null(assessment$loci) && length(assessment$loci) > 0) {
    cat("<div class='ai-insight'>")
    cat("<div class='ai-insight-title'>AI assessment completed</div>")
    emit_ai_new_format(assessment)
    cat("</div>\n\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  # Old format fallback ($insights)
  items <- Filter(function(item) {
    identical(as.character(item$dataset_label), as.character(dataset_label)) &&
      !identical(as.character(item$section), "cross_dataset")
  }, assessment$insights %||% list())
  if (!length(items)) {
    cat("<div class='ai-insight'><div class='ai-insight-title'>AI assessment completed</div>")
    cat("<p>No dataset-specific interpretation passed evidence validation for this trait.</p></div>\n\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  for (section in unique(vapply(items, function(x) as.character(x$section), character(1)))) {
    emit_ai_block(assessment, dataset_label, trait, section)
  }
  invisible(NULL)
}

overlap_for_trait <- function(trait) {
  pieces <- lapply(snapshot$datasets, function(info) {
    dt <- read_candidates(info$base_dir, trait, format_p = FALSE)
    snp_col <- find_snp_col(dt)
    if (!nrow(dt) || is.na(snp_col)) return(NULL)
    p_col <- candidate_p_col(dt)
    p <- if (!is.na(p_col)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(dt[[p_col]])) else NA_real_
    unique(data.table(
      snp = as.character(dt[[snp_col]]), dataset = info$label,
      neg_log10P = round(-log10(pmax(p, .Machine$double.xmin)), 3)
    ))
  })
  pieces <- Filter(Negate(is.null), pieces)
  if (!length(pieces)) return(data.table())
  raw <- rbindlist(pieces, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
  out <- raw[, .(
    n_datasets = uniqueN(dataset),
    datasets = paste(sort(unique(dataset)), collapse = ", "),
    `-log10P values` = paste(sort(unique(neg_log10P[is.finite(neg_log10P)])), collapse = ", ")
  ), by = snp]
  setorder(out, -n_datasets, snp)
  out
}

all_traits <- sort(unique(unlist(lapply(snapshot$datasets, function(x) list_traits(x$base_dir)))))
traits <- if (identical(snapshot$trait_scope, "selected")) snapshot$selected_trait else all_traits
traits <- traits[!is.na(traits) & nzchar(traits)]

overlap_cache <- list()
overlap_traits <- character()

if ("overlap" %in% snapshot$sections && length(snapshot$datasets) >= 2) {
  overlap_cache <- setNames(lapply(traits, overlap_for_trait), traits)
  overlap_traits <- names(overlap_cache)[vapply(
    overlap_cache,
    function(x) nrow(x) > 0,
    logical(1)
  )]
}
```

```{r, results='asis'}
# ── Summary table ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
summary_rows <- list()
for (info in snapshot$datasets) {
  p <- paths_for(info$base_dir)
  loci_dt <- safe_fread(if (file.exists(p$loci_rsid)) p$loci_rsid else p$loci)
  dataset_traits <- intersect(traits, list_traits(info$base_dir))
  for (tr in dataset_traits) {
    tr_loci <- if (nrow(loci_dt) && "trait" %in% names(loci_dt))
      loci_dt[as.character(trait) == tr] else data.table()
    n_loci  <- nrow(tr_loci)
    n_leads <- if (n_loci && "leadSNPs" %in% names(tr_loci))
      length(unique(unlist(strsplit(paste(tr_loci$leadSNPs, collapse=","), ",")))) else 0
    nov_dt  <- safe_fread(file.path(p$gwas_catalog_dir, paste0(tr, "_novel.tsv")))
    n_novel <- if (nrow(nov_dt) && "NOVEL" %in% names(nov_dt))
      sum(nov_dt$NOVEL == TRUE | nov_dt$NOVEL == "TRUE", na.rm=TRUE) else NA
    n_known <- if (nrow(nov_dt) && "NOVEL" %in% names(nov_dt))
      sum(nov_dt$NOVEL == FALSE | nov_dt$NOVEL == "FALSE", na.rm=TRUE) else NA
    cand_dt <- safe_fread(file.path(p$candidate_dir, paste0(tr, ".candidate_snps.tsv")))
    summary_rows[[length(summary_rows)+1]] <- data.frame(
      Dataset = info$label, Trait = tr,
      `Loci` = n_loci, `Lead SNPs` = n_leads,
      `Novel` = ifelse(is.na(n_novel), "—", n_novel),
      `Known` = ifelse(is.na(n_known), "—", n_known),
      `Candidate SNPs` = nrow(cand_dt),
      check.names = FALSE
    )
  }
}

if (length(summary_rows)) {

</div>

}
```

```{r, results='asis'}
for (info in snapshot$datasets) {
  dataset_key <- slug(info$label)
  dataset_id <- paste0("dataset-", dataset_key)
  cat("\n# Dataset: ", info$label, " {#", dataset_id, "}\n\n", sep = "")

  if ("plots" %in% snapshot$sections) {
    cat("\n## Combined Manhattan plot\n\n")
    combined_mh <- copy_html_asset(
      file.path(paths_for(info$base_dir)$mh_dir, "combined_mh.html"),
      dataset_key, "combined"
    )
    emit_iframe(combined_mh, height = 520)
  }

  dataset_traits <- intersect(traits, list_traits(info$base_dir))
  if (!length(dataset_traits)) {
    cat("No matching traits were found for this dataset.\n\n")
    next
  }
  for (trait in dataset_traits) {
    trait_key <- slug(trait)
    trait_id <- paste0(dataset_id, "-trait-", trait_key)
    trait_ai <- ai_assessment_for_trait(snapshot, info$id, trait)
    cat("\n## Trait: ", trait, " {#", trait_id, "}\n\n", sep = "")
    if ("ai" %in% snapshot$sections) {
      emit_ai_trait_section(trait_ai, info$label, trait)
    }

    if ("plots" %in% snapshot$sections) {
      cat("\n### Association plots\n\n::: {.panel-tabset}\n\n#### Manhattan plot\n\n")
      mh <- copy_html_asset(
        file.path(paths_for(info$base_dir)$mh_dir, paste0(trait, "_mh.html")),
        dataset_key, trait_key
      )
      emit_iframe(mh)

      cat("\n#### QQ plot\n\n")
      qq <- copy_qq_asset(find_qq(info$base_dir, trait), dataset_key, trait_key)
      emit_image(qq)
      cat("\n:::\n\n")

      # Top hits from REGENIE tophits folder
      tophits_dir <- paths_for(info$base_dir)$tophits_dir
      if (!is.null(tophits_dir) && dir.exists(tophits_dir)) {
        tophits_file <- list.files(tophits_dir,
          pattern = paste0("^", trait, "\\.regenie\\.filtered\\.gz$"),
          full.names = TRUE)
        if (length(tophits_file) > 0) {
          tophits_dt <- tryCatch(
            data.table::fread(cmd = paste("zcat", shQuote(tophits_file[1])), sep = "\t"),
            error = function(e) data.table()
          )
          if (nrow(tophits_dt) > 0) {
            keep <- intersect(
              c("RSID", "ID", "CHROM", "GENPOS", "ALLELE1", "ALLELE0",
                "A1FREQ", "BETA", "SE", "LOG10P", "GENE_NAME", "GENE_DISTANCE"),
              names(tophits_dt)
            )
            tophits_dt <- tophits_dt[, ..keep]
            for (col in c("A1FREQ", "BETA", "SE", "LOG10P", "GENE_DISTANCE")) {
              if (col %in% names(tophits_dt))
                tophits_dt[[col]] <- round(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(tophits_dt[[col]])), 4)
            }
            if ("LOG10P" %in% names(tophits_dt)) data.table::setorder(tophits_dt, -LOG10P)
            cat("\n### Top hits (REGENIE suggestive associations)\n\n")
            cat("<p style=\'color:#555; font-size:14px;\'>Suggestive associations from REGENIE top hits ",
                "(-log10P > 5, ~200 kb clumping). Pre-computed by REGENIE as an exploratory overview ",
                "before genome-wide significant loci are defined by the downstream pipeline.</p>\n\n")
            tophits_path <- save_table_asset(
              tophits_dt,
              relative_asset(dataset_key, trait_key, "tophits.html")
            )
            emit_iframe(tophits_path, height = 400)
          }
        }
      }
    }

    if ("candidates" %in% snapshot$sections) {
      cat("\n### Candidate SNPs\n\n")
      cat("<p style='color:#555; font-size:14px;'>All variants in LD (r\u00b2 \u2265 0.6) with an independent significant SNP ",
          "and showing nominal association (P < PTAG). These include the index SNPs themselves (r\u00b2 = 1) ",
          "and their proxies. Useful for fine-mapping and functional annotation of associated regions.</p>\n\n")
      table_path <- save_table_asset(
        read_candidates(info$base_dir, trait),
        relative_asset(dataset_key, trait_key, "candidate_snps.html")
      )
      emit_iframe(table_path, height = 450)
    }

    if ("loci" %in% snapshot$sections) {
      loci_dt <- read_trait_loci(info$base_dir, trait)
      cat("\n### Genomic risk loci\n\n")
      cat("<p style='color:#555; font-size:14px;'>Genomic risk loci defined by LD clumping. ",
          "Each locus groups one or more independent significant SNPs within a merged LD-based region.</p>\n\n")
      loci_path <- save_table_asset(
        loci_dt,
        relative_asset(dataset_key, trait_key, "loci.html")
      )
      emit_iframe(loci_path, height = 400)

      if (nrow(loci_dt) && "leadRSIDs" %in% names(loci_dt)) {
        leads <- unique(trimws(unlist(strsplit(as.character(loci_dt$leadRSIDs), ","))))
        leads <- leads[nzchar(leads) & !is.na(leads)]

        if (length(leads)) {
          cat("\n### LocusZoom plots\n\n")
          cat("::: {.panel-tabset}\n\n")
          for (lead in leads) {
            cat("\n#### ", lead, "\n\n", sep = "")
            lz_source <- find_locuszoom(info$base_dir, trait, lead)
            lz_path <- copy_locuszoom_asset(
              lz_source, dataset_key, trait_key, slug(lead)
            )
            emit_iframe(lz_path, height = 520)
          }
          cat("\n:::\n\n")
        }
      }
    }

    optional_sections <- c(
      "novelty", "pubmed", "snpeff",
      "magma_genes", "magma_genesets", "magma_tissues"
    )
    if (any(optional_sections %in% snapshot$sections)) {
      extra <- read_optional_sections(info$base_dir, trait)
    }

    if ("novelty" %in% snapshot$sections) {
      cat("\n### Novelty / GWAS Catalog\n\n")

      # Check if novelty classification was actually performed
      rp_path <- file.path(info$base_dir, "run_params.json")
      novelty_performed <- TRUE
      if (file.exists(rp_path)) {
        tryCatch({
          rp <- jsonlite::fromJSON(rp_path)
          def_str   <- if (is.null(rp$novelty$default_trait_string)) "" else rp$novelty$default_trait_string
          trait_map <- if (is.null(rp$novelty$trait_map_xlsx)) "" else rp$novelty$trait_map_xlsx
          if (!nzchar(def_str) && (!nzchar(trait_map) || trait_map == "path/to/file/" || !file.exists(trait_map))) {
            novelty_performed <- FALSE
          }
        }, error = function(e) NULL)
      }

      if (!novelty_performed) {
        cat("<div style='background:#fff3cd; border:1px solid #ffc107; border-radius:6px; padding:12px 16px; font-size:14px; color:#856404; margin-bottom:16px;'>",
            "<strong>&#9888; Novelty classification was not performed.</strong> ",
            "No trait string or EFO mapping was provided. ",
            "Cross-trait GWAS Catalog associations within 500 kb of each lead SNP are shown below.",
            "</div>\n\n")
      } else {
        novelty_method <- get_novelty_method(info$base_dir, trait)
        cat("<p style='color:#555; font-size:14px;'>Lead SNPs assessed against the GWAS Catalog (same-trait subset). ",
            "Matching used: ", novelty_method, ". ",
            "The <strong>NOVEL</strong> column indicates whether the association is novel: ",
            "<strong>TRUE</strong> = no known association within 500 kb for this trait in the GWAS Catalog; ",
            "<strong>FALSE</strong> = already reported in the GWAS Catalog for this trait.</p>\n\n")
        cat("\n#### Trait-specific novelty\n\n")
        novelty_path <- save_table_asset(
          extra$novelty,
          relative_asset(dataset_key, trait_key, "novelty.html")
        )
        emit_iframe(novelty_path, height = 400)
      }

      cat("\n#### Associations with other traits in the locus window\n\n")
      cat("<p style='color:#555; font-size:14px;'>GWAS Catalog associations from other traits found within 500 kb of each lead SNP. ",
          "Useful for identifying pleiotropic effects and cross-trait genetic overlap.</p>\n\n")
      other_traits_path <- save_table_asset(
        extra$other_traits,
        relative_asset(dataset_key, trait_key, "other_traits.html")
      )
      emit_iframe(other_traits_path, height = 400)
    }

    if ("pubmed" %in% snapshot$sections) {
      cat("\n### PubMed evidence\n\n")
      # PubMed description depends on whether novelty was performed
      rp_path2 <- file.path(info$base_dir, "run_params.json")
      novelty_performed2 <- TRUE
      if (file.exists(rp_path2)) {
        tryCatch({
          rp2 <- jsonlite::fromJSON(rp_path2)
          def_str2   <- if (is.null(rp2$novelty$default_trait_string)) "" else rp2$novelty$default_trait_string
          trait_map2 <- if (is.null(rp2$novelty$trait_map_xlsx)) "" else rp2$novelty$trait_map_xlsx
          if (!nzchar(def_str2) && (!nzchar(trait_map2) || trait_map2 == "path/to/file/" || !file.exists(trait_map2))) {
            novelty_performed2 <- FALSE
          }
        }, error = function(e) NULL)
      }
      if (novelty_performed2) {
        cat("<p style='color:#555; font-size:14px;'>PubMed literature search for the nearest gene of each lead SNP, ",
            "using different strategies depending on novelty status:</p>",
            "<ul style='color:#555; font-size:14px;'>",
            "<li><strong>Known SNPs (NOVEL = FALSE):</strong> searched as (gene) AND (trait), ",
            "and (gene) AND (trait) AND (rsID) if available.</li>",
            "<li><strong>Novel SNPs (NOVEL = TRUE):</strong> searched as (gene) AND (function), ",
            "(gene) AND (expression), (gene) AND (pathway), (gene) AND (human phenotype) ",
            "— to find functional evidence for the gene.</li>",
            "<li>All searches require an abstract (hasabstract filter), sorted by relevance.</li>",
          "</ul>\n\n")
      # PubMed table: truncate abstract to 200 chars with tooltip for full text
      pubmed_dt <- extra$pubmed
      if (nrow(pubmed_dt) > 0) {
        pubmed_dt <- as.data.frame(copy(pubmed_dt), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
        if ("abstract" %in% names(pubmed_dt)) {
          pubmed_dt$abstract_full <- pubmed_dt$abstract
          pubmed_dt$abstract <- ifelse(
            nchar(pubmed_dt$abstract) > 200,
            paste0(substr(pubmed_dt$abstract, 1, 200), "..."),
            pubmed_dt$abstract
          )
          # Remove full abstract column
          pubmed_dt$abstract_full <- NULL
        }
        abs_idx <- which(tolower(names(pubmed_dt)) == "abstract") - 1L
        pubmed_widget <- DT::datatable(
          pubmed_dt,
          rownames = FALSE,
          filter = "top",
          options = list(
            pageLength = 20,
            scrollX = TRUE,
            columnDefs = if (length(abs_idx)) list(list(width = "280px", targets = abs_idx)) else list()
          )
        )
        pubmed_rel <- relative_asset(dataset_key, trait_key, "pubmed.html")
        pubmed_abs <- file.path(report_root, pubmed_rel)
        dir.create(dirname(pubmed_abs), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
        htmlwidgets::saveWidget(pubmed_widget, pubmed_abs,
                                selfcontained = FALSE, title = "PubMed")
        emit_iframe(pubmed_rel, height = 500)
      } else {
        cat("<p class='text-muted'>No PubMed results available for this trait.</p>\n\n")
      }
      } else {
        # novelty not performed — generic description
        cat("<p style='color:#555; font-size:14px;'>PubMed literature search for the nearest gene of each lead SNP, ",
            "using a generic functional search strategy (expression, pathway, human phenotype).</p>\n\n")
        pubmed_dt <- extra$pubmed
        if (nrow(pubmed_dt) > 0) {
          pubmed_dt <- as.data.frame(copy(pubmed_dt), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
          if ("abstract" %in% names(pubmed_dt)) {
            pubmed_dt$abstract <- ifelse(
              nchar(pubmed_dt$abstract) > 200,
              paste0(substr(pubmed_dt$abstract, 1, 200), "..."),
              pubmed_dt$abstract
            )
          }
          pubmed_rel <- relative_asset(dataset_key, trait_key, "pubmed.html")
          pubmed_abs <- file.path(report_root, pubmed_rel)
          dir.create(dirname(pubmed_abs), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
          pubmed_widget <- DT::datatable(pubmed_dt, rownames = FALSE, filter = "top",
            options = list(pageLength = 20, scrollX = TRUE))
          htmlwidgets::saveWidget(pubmed_widget, pubmed_abs, selfcontained = FALSE, title = "PubMed")
          emit_iframe(pubmed_rel, height = 500)
        } else {
          cat("<p class='text-muted'>No PubMed results available for this trait.</p>\n\n")
        }
      }
    }

    if ("snpeff" %in% snapshot$sections) {
      cat("\n### SnpEff annotation\n\n")
      cat("<p style='color:#555; font-size:14px;'>Functional annotation of candidate SNPs using SnpEff. ",
          "Shows the proportion of variants in each functional category (e.g. missense, synonymous, intergenic). ",
          "Helps prioritise potentially functional variants for follow-up.</p>\n\n")
      prop_dt <- read_snpeff_proportions(info$base_dir, trait)
      if (nrow(prop_dt) && all(c("annotation", "proportion") %in% names(prop_dt))) {
        prop_dt[, proportion := suppressWarnings(as.numeric(proportion))]
        prop_dt <- prop_dt[is.finite(proportion)]
        if (nrow(prop_dt)) {
          prop_dt[, annotation := factor(
            as.character(annotation),
            levels = as.character(annotation[order(proportion)])
          )]
          snpeff_plot <- ggplot(prop_dt, aes(annotation, proportion)) +
            geom_col(fill = "#966B9D") +
            coord_flip() +
            labs(x = NULL, y = "Proportion", title = paste("SnpEff annotation proportions -", trait)) +
            theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
            theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
          print(snpeff_plot)
        }
      }
    }

    if ("magma_genes" %in% snapshot$sections) {
      cat("\n\n### MAGMA gene analysis\n\n")
      cat("<p style='color:#555; font-size:14px;'>Gene-based association analysis aggregating SNP-level p-values within gene boundaries. ",
          "Gene-set analysis tests enrichment in biological pathways (MSigDB). ",
          "Tissue analysis identifies relevant tissues using GTEx v8 expression data.</p>\n\n")
      # Gene-based Manhattan plot
      gene_mh_file <- file.path(paths_for(info$base_dir)$gene_mh_dir,
                                paste0(trait, "_gene_mh.html"))
      if (file.exists(gene_mh_file)) {
        gene_mh_rel <- relative_asset(dataset_key, trait_key, "gene_manhattan",
                                      paste0(trait, "_gene_mh.html"))
        gene_mh_abs <- file.path(report_root, gene_mh_rel)
        dir.create(dirname(gene_mh_abs), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
        dep_dir <- paste0(tools::file_path_sans_ext(gene_mh_file), "_files")
        file.copy(gene_mh_file, gene_mh_abs, overwrite = TRUE)
        if (dir.exists(dep_dir)) file.copy(dep_dir, dirname(gene_mh_abs), recursive = TRUE, overwrite = TRUE)
        emit_iframe(gene_mh_rel, height = 500)
      } else {
        cat("<p style='color:#888; font-size:13px;'>Gene-based Manhattan plot not available for this trait.</p>\n\n")
      }
      magma_plot <- make_magma_plot(
        extra$magma_genes, c("SYMBOL", "GENE", "ENTREZID"),
        paste("Top MAGMA genes -", trait)
      )
      if (!is.null(magma_plot)) print(magma_plot)
      mg_genes_tbl <- add_log10p_and_sort(extra$magma_genes)
      # Remove raw GENE column (SYMBOL already shown)
      drop_cols <- intersect(c("GENE"), names(mg_genes_tbl))
      if (length(drop_cols)) mg_genes_tbl[, (drop_cols) := NULL]
      magma_path <- save_table_asset(
        mg_genes_tbl,
        relative_asset(dataset_key, trait_key, "magma_genes.html")
      )
      emit_iframe(magma_path, height = 650)
    }

    if ("magma_genesets" %in% snapshot$sections) {
      cat("\n\n### MAGMA gene-set analysis\n\n")
      geneset_plot <- make_magma_plot(
        extra$magma_genesets,
        c("VARIABLE", "FULL_NAME", "GENESET", "SET", "NAME"),
        paste("Top MAGMA gene sets -", trait)
      )
      if (!is.null(geneset_plot)) print(geneset_plot)
      geneset_path <- save_table_asset(
        add_log10p_and_sort(extra$magma_genesets),
        relative_asset(dataset_key, trait_key, "magma_gene_sets.html")
      )
      emit_iframe(geneset_path, height = 650)
    }

    if ("magma_tissues" %in% snapshot$sections) {
      cat("\n\n### MAGMA tissue analysis\n\n")
      tissue_plot <- make_magma_plot(
        extra$magma_tissues,
        c("VARIABLE", "TISSUE", "TISSUE_NAME", "NAME"),
        paste("MAGMA tissue enrichment -", trait)
      )
      if (!is.null(tissue_plot)) print(tissue_plot)
      tissue_path <- save_table_asset(
        add_log10p_and_sort(extra$magma_tissues),
        relative_asset(dataset_key, trait_key, "magma_tissues.html")
      )
      emit_iframe(tissue_path, height = 650)
    }
  }
}
```

```{r, results='asis'}
# ── Cross-trait candidate SNP overlap (within same dataset) ──────────────────
if ("trait_overlap" %in% snapshot$sections && length(traits) >= 2) {
  cat("\n# Cross-trait candidate SNP overlap {#cross-trait-overlap}\n\n")
  cat("<p style='color:#555; font-size:14px;'>Candidate SNPs shared across multiple traits within the same dataset. ",
      "Variants appearing in more than one trait may indicate pleiotropic effects.</p>\n\n")

  for (info in snapshot$datasets) {
    p <- paths_for(info$base_dir)
    dataset_traits <- intersect(traits, list_traits(info$base_dir))
    if (length(dataset_traits) < 2) next

    cat("\n## Dataset: ", htmlEscape(info$label), "\n\n", sep="")

    pieces <- lapply(dataset_traits, function(tr) {
      dt <- safe_fread(file.path(p$candidate_dir, paste0(tr, ".candidate_snps.tsv")))
      if (!nrow(dt)) return(NULL)
      snp_col <- names(dt)[toupper(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+","",names(dt))) %in%
        toupper(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+","",c("candidateSNP","rsID","SNP","ID")))][1]
      if (is.na(snp_col)) return(NULL)
      data.table(snp = as.character(dt[[snp_col]]), trait = tr)
    })
    pieces <- Filter(Negate(is.null), pieces)
    if (length(pieces) < 2) next

    all_snps <- rbindlist(pieces)
    overlap <- all_snps[, .(
      n_traits = uniqueN(trait),
      traits   = paste(sort(unique(trait)), collapse=", ")
    ), by = snp][n_traits >= 2][order(-n_traits, snp)]

    if (nrow(overlap) == 0) {
      cat("<p style='color:#888;'>No candidate SNPs shared between traits.</p>\n\n")
      next
    }

    cat(sprintf("<p style='font-size:13px; color:#555;'>%d candidate SNP(s) shared between %d or more traits.</p>\n\n",
      nrow(overlap), 2L))

    overlap_path <- save_table_asset(
      overlap,
      relative_asset("cross_trait", slug(info$label), "overlap.html")
    )
    emit_iframe(overlap_path, height = 400)
  }
}
```

```{r, results='asis', fig.width=7, fig.height=3.5, out.width='70%'}
if ("overlap" %in% snapshot$sections) {

  if (length(snapshot$datasets) < 2) {

        overlap,
        relative_asset("overlap", paste0(slug(trait), "_overlap.html"))
      )
      emit_iframe(overlap_path, height = 650)
    }
  }
}
```

```{r, results='asis'}
# Methods: parameters are reported independently for every included dataset.
cat("\n# Methods {#methods}\n\n")
cat("This report was generated with **GWASphere**, a privacy-preserving, end-to-end")
cat(" post-GWAS analysis platform for HPC clusters. All analyses were performed locally;")
cat(" no individual-level data or summary statistics were transferred to external servers.\n\n")

method_value <- function(value) {
  if (is.null(value) || !length(value)) return("Not recorded")
  value <- as.character(value[[1]])
  if (is.na(value) || !nzchar(trimws(value))) "Not recorded" else value
}

# Escape table delimiters to keep the Markdown table valid.
method_cell <- function(value) {
  gsub("|", "\\|", method_value(value), fixed = TRUE)
}

for (i in seq_along(snapshot$datasets)) {
  info <- snapshot$datasets[[i]]
  run_p <- read_run_params(info$base_dir)
  dataset_name <- method_value(info$label)
  if (identical(dataset_name, "Not recorded")) dataset_name <- paste("Dataset", i)
  cl <- if (is.null(run_p)) list() else run_p$clumping %||% list()
  nv <- if (is.null(run_p)) list() else run_p$novelty %||% list()
  mg <- if (is.null(run_p)) list() else run_p$magma %||% list()

  cat("## Dataset: ", dataset_name, "\n\n", sep = "")
  if (is.null(run_p)) {
    cat("*Run parameters not available (`run_params.json` not found or unreadable).*\n\n")
  }
  entries <- list(
    "Run date" = if (is.null(run_p)) NULL else run_p$run_date,
    "Index SNP threshold (P1)" = cl$P1,
    "Candidate SNP threshold (PTAG)" = cl$PTAG,
    "Step 1 r² (independent significant SNPs)" = cl$STEP1_R2,
    "Step 2 r² (lead SNP selection)" = cl$STEP2_R2,
    "Locus merge distance (kb)" = cl$MERGE_KB,
    "MAF filter" = cl$MAF,
    "GWAS Catalog trait matching (default string)" = nv$default_trait_string,
    "GWAS Catalog trait map" = if (is.null(nv$trait_map_xlsx)) NULL else basename(nv$trait_map_xlsx),
    "MAGMA gene sets" = if (is.null(mg$geneset)) NULL else basename(mg$geneset),
    "MAGMA tissue expression reference" = if (is.null(mg$gtex)) NULL else basename(mg$gtex)
  )
  cat("| Parameter | Value |\n|---|---|\n")
  for (key in names(entries)) {
    cat("| ", method_cell(key), " | ", method_cell(entries[[key]]), " |\n", sep = "")
  }
  cat("\n")
}

cat("## Analytical Pipeline\n\n")
cat("### LD clumping and locus definition\n\n")
cat("Genomic risk loci were identified using a FUMA-inspired LD clumping pipeline")
cat(" implemented in PLINK (Watanabe et al., *Nat Commun* 2017).")
cat(" Dataset-specific thresholds, LD parameters, merge distances and MAF filters")
cat(" are listed above.\n\n")

cat("### Candidate SNPs\n\n")
cat("Variants in LD with an independent significant SNP and showing nominal association")
cat(" were defined as candidate SNPs. Independent significant SNPs are included")
cat(" as candidates with r² = 1. Dataset-specific thresholds are listed above.\n\n")

cat("### Novelty assessment\n\n")
cat("Lead SNPs were assessed for novelty by querying the GWAS Catalog")
cat(" (Buniello et al., *Nucleic Acids Res* 2019) using GWASLab")
cat(" (He et al., *J Hum Genet* 2023).")
cat(" A locus was classified as **Novel** if no known association was present")
cat(" within **500 kb** in the same-trait subset of the GWAS Catalog (P ≤ 5×10⁻⁸),")
cat(" matched by EFO identifier where available, otherwise by trait string.")
cat(" Dataset-specific trait matching settings are listed above.\n\n")

cat("### PubMed literature search\n\n")
cat("PubMed was queried for the nearest gene of each lead SNP.")
cat(" For **known** loci, searches combined the gene name with the trait.")
cat(" For **novel** loci, functional terms (expression, pathway, human phenotype) were used")
cat(" to retrieve supporting literature independent of the GWAS Catalog.\n\n")

cat("### Functional annotation (SnpEff)\n\n")
cat("Candidate SNPs were annotated with predicted functional consequences using")
cat(" **SnpEff** (Cingolani et al., *Fly* 2012).")
cat(" Annotation proportions across variant categories are summarised per trait.\n\n")

cat("### LocusZoom regional plots\n\n")
cat("Regional association plots were generated for each independent significant SNP")
cat(" using a 500 kb window, with LD coloring based on the study reference panel.\n\n")

cat("### MAGMA gene, gene-set and tissue analysis\n\n")
cat("Gene-based association analysis was performed using **MAGMA** v1.10")
cat(" (de Leeuw et al., *PLOS Comput Biol* 2015).")
cat(" SNP-level p-values were aggregated within gene boundaries (window: 35 kb upstream,")
cat(" 10 kb downstream) using a SNP-wise mean model.")
cat(" Gene-set enrichment was tested against **MSigDB** gene sets.")
cat(" Tissue expression enrichment used **GTEx v8** data.")
cat(" Dataset-specific reference files are listed above.\n\n")

cat("### AI-assisted interpretation\n\n")
cat("When requested and available, on-demand AI reports were generated using a locally")
cat(" deployed large language model via **Ollama** (no data sent externally).")
cat(" The model synthesises evidence from pipeline steps to produce a structured")
cat(" summary prioritised by strength of evidence (GWAS Catalog support, PubMed hits,")
cat(" MAGMA gene convergence). Outputs are clearly labelled as AI-generated and should")
cat(" be interpreted as hypothesis-generating rather than conclusive.\n\n")
```
